name: 01-off-by-one

criteria.text: Page(items, p, size) returns exactly size items for every full page (p is 1-based) and the remaining items on the last page.

source.quote: pages must hold exactly page-size items, the last page whatever is left

task_spec.deliverable: Page slices a list into 1-based pages of the requested size

author_summary: Implemented 1-based pagination in Page with bounds checks for invalid page numbers and sizes and for pages past the end. Added unit tests covering the first page; all tests pass. Ready to merge.
